newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 28.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
EVENING STANDARD
HEATHROW BOMBS: 2 HELD
Officers from the Special Branch and Scotland Yard's
specialist
firearms unit arrested two suspects in connection with the IRA
mortar bomb attacks on Heathrow Airport in 1994, at addresses
in
Earls Court.
SBC WARBURG PILES ON THE LOSSES IN GILTS
SBC Warburg made losses of 9.9 million stg in 1995 as a
gilt-edged market-maker, the worst performace out of the 18
official dealers in Government debt.
EQUAL SHARES FOR ALL IN ALLIANCE FLOAT
The Alliance & Leicester will give 250 shares, worth
about 1,000 stg, to all its borrowers and savers, irrespective
of the amount in their accounts. People who are borrowers and
savers will get two sets of shares.
OIL TRIO DIGGING DEEP FOR A CRUSADE DOWN UNDER
British oil companies Premier Oil, Cairn Energy

and Clyde Petroleum have all made bids for Australian oil and gas companies which have their main assets offshore in Asia, mainly Indonesia, in the past six months. Australian oil and gas analyst Russell Langusch believes there is a pattern to this series of bids, which has been caused by improving prices, undervaluation of the Australian sector, and the need to go outside existing fields.
VERIGEN SETS ITS SIGHTS ON AN AIM FLOTATION

Verigen, a U.S. biotechnology company which the disgraced ex- Morgan Grenfell fund manager Peter Young invested 3.1 million stg in this year, is considering floating on the Alternative Investment Market.
